# Rahul Chanda Photography

> Commercial and product photography studio in Dehradun, India. Specializing in product, food & beverage, footwear, and brand advertising campaigns with in-house retouching.

## Services

- [Product Photography](/services/product-photography): E-commerce packshots, white background cutouts, creative product hero imagery for Shopify, Amazon, and D2C brands.
- [Food & Beverage Photography](/services/food-beverage-photography): Restaurant menu shoots, beverage splash photography, cafe atmosphere imagery.
- [Footwear & Fashion Photography](/services/footwear-fashion-photography): Apparel lookbooks, footwear details, editorial fashion campaigns.
- [Commercial & Advertising Photography](/services/commercial-campaigns): Art-directed advertising shoots from concept to final retouched deliverables.
- [Dehradun Photography](/dehradun): Local commercial photography across Uttarakhand including Dehradun, Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Haridwar.
